title: WPMS/717/1998 of BRAHAM SINGH Vs ASSISTANT DIRECTOR CAMP and ORS

paras.text:
WPMS No.717 / 1998 (Old No.)
Hon'ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Heard Mr. A. V. Pundir, the learned counsel for the
petitioner and Mr. M. S. Tyagi, the learned counsel for the
respondent nos.5 to 7 on the Restoration Application
No.196/2011.
There is a delay in filing the restoration application.
Perused the delay condonation application No.2430/2011. Cause
shown for the delay in filing the restoration application is
sufficient. The Delay Condonation Application / CLMA
No.2430/2011 is allowed. The delay in filing the restoration
application is condoned.
Perused the restoration application. Cause shown in the
restoration application is sufficient. The Restoration Application
is allowed. The order dated 24.02.2010, by which the writ
petition was dismissed for want of prosecution, is recalled.
Also heard on the merits of the case.
Having heard the learned counsel for the parties, the court
finds that respondent no.4 & 8 have died several years ago and an
opportunity to substitute the heirs of respondent nos.4 & 8 was
granted to the petitioner as far back in the year 2009, inspite of
which, no substitution application has been filed. In view of the
aforesaid, the writ petition against respondent no.4 & 8 stands
dismissed as abated.
The present proceeding arises out of allotment of chak
under Section 21 of the Uttar Pradesh Consolidation of Holdings
Act, 1960. Respondent nos.4 & 8 were granted a chak pursuant
to the impugned orders. Since the writ petition has been
dismissed against them as abated, the court is of the opinion that
the writ petition against the other contesting respondents cannot
continue in as much as any order passed by this court modifying
the impugned orders would adversely affect the rights of the
respondent nos.4 & 8 and their heirs. Since I have already
dismissed the writ petition against respondent nos.4 & 8, the
court is of the opinion that the entire writ petition is liable to be
dismissed and is accordingly dismissed.
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.)
Dated 14.12.2011
LSR
